en-US:
Temporary chat now opens from the New Task launchpad and keeps its compact header menu; it reuses normal chat and voice input with configured, authorized read-only tools. It survives backgrounding, leaving cancels and discards it, and Keep saves it without resending requests.
Subagents discover tools and Skills without loading the whole catalog, and child runs are recorded durably so you can inspect them while they run and after they finish. Waiting tasks show which background work they are waiting for, and complete background-job output can be read page by page.
Provider settings now follow each model's real capabilities; existing configurations are reviewed once and your explicit choices are preserved. CAD editing is task-authorized, with clearer drawing and assembly summaries. Storage shows this app's own usage as a numeric total with matching category details, and Shared Files as a separate section.
Notes gains custom covers (chosen manually or set by the assistant), an Excel-first workbook cover, and a read-only text reader with manual encoding selection for legacy files. Task Center can archive or delete several tasks at once. When an auxiliary model is configured, automatic reasoning effort is decided once per round with a safe fallback. Notification and Linux terminal handling fixes are included. Component and Simulator results do not replace physical-device acceptance.
zh-Hans:
临时会话现在从“新建任务”启动台进入，保留顶部精简菜单；复用正常聊天与语音输入，并按实际配置与授权提供只读工具。切后台保留会话，真正离开则取消并销毁；保留为正式会话不重复发送请求。
子助手可自行发现工具与 Skill，无需一次加载全部目录；子运行记录持久化，运行中和完成后都能查看。等待中的任务会显示在等哪些后台作业，完整作业输出可分页阅读。
供应商设置按每个模型的实际能力工作；已有配置只需一次核对，你的显式选择会保留。CAD 编辑使用任务授权，绘图与装配摘要更清楚。存储显示本应用自身占用的数值总计和对应分类明细，共享文件单独成区。
手记支持自定义封面（手动选择或由助手设置）、Excel 优先的工作簿封面，以及带手动编码选择的只读文本阅读器。任务中心可批量归档或删除。配置了辅助模型时，真正的自动思考强度每轮只决定一次，异常时安全回退。本轮还包含系统通知与 Linux 终端修复。组件与模拟器结果不代表真机性能。
